task_message:
Case N33: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 211x211x88 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The peripheral nerve sheath tumor has been segmented and saved.

**Result:** 27.4 mL single-component mask covering the ovoid T2-hyperintense subcutaneous mass at the anterior aspect of the limb.

**Workflow used:**
1. `seg_open` + axial/sagittal/coronal contact sheets localized the lesion (ovoid bright mass spanning axial slices 37–79, clearly distinct from the small skin-marker dot seen superficial to it at the ends).
2. A 3-point positive prompt on the mid-slice core produced a good initial mask (v1, 28.1 mL).
3. Verified the ends and boundary at high zoom in all three planes, cross-checked intensity-based candidates (none found — mask edges coincide with the intensity boundary), then ran one `seg_refine` to tighten the contour (v2, 27.4 mL, −0.7 mL trimming).
4. Final review: no lesion tissue in the past-the-mask slices in any plane, no stray components, outline follows the lesion boundary (including its slightly heterogeneous core and less intense periphery).
